title: P300 BCI EEG dataset (Chailloux Peguero et al. 2020)
description: A P300 brain-computer interface EEG dataset comprising recordings from 19 healthy participants across 3 sessions each, using a P300 paradigm with visual stimuli (standard flash and cartoon face presentations across 5 grid sizes). The dataset includes 8-channel EEG recordings sampled at 256 Hz with events classified as target and non-target stimuli, designed to evaluate P300-based BCI performance under varying visual stimulation conditions.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 8 passive g.SCARABEO sensors positioned at Fz, Cz, P3, Pz, P4, PO7, PO8, and Oz according to the standard 10-20 montage. Sampling rate was 256 Hz with right earlobe reference and AFz ground. The P300 paradigm employed visual stimuli (standard flash and cartoon face) presented at 150 ms stimulus onset asynchrony with 75 ms inter-stimulus interval. Participants completed 7 runs per session with approximately 198 flashes per block and 6 blocks per run.
